init_hook: if ! rustc --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "${RUST_VERSION}"; then rustup install ${RUST_VERSION} && rustup default ${RUST_VERSION}; fi
rustup component list --installed 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^rust-analyzer' || rustup component add rust-analyzer
rustup target list --installed 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'wasm32-wasip1' || rustup target add wasm32-wasip1
